## 8b5f756cc8ea

**Audited source.** `generators/8b5f756cc8ea/generator.py`, SHA-256 `82da287d27b88a025ac6657007ead4e8deab9da127741ac33012bdaa688221d2`. No source files for this target were edited.

**Finding A1 — declared controls are ignored or clamped.** At seed `12345`, sample index `7`, difficulty `medium`, the default draw and draws with `anchor_corner=True`, `palette_size=3`, or unknown `invented_axis=42` are byte-identical (grid SHA-256 `4078e3cea16e2a2537f6da52db42febb0e268a6a31257eb8e98712df720d8f5d`). Requesting the declared `n_frames=7` also produces the same grid with only three components because the implementation clamps `n_frames` to at most three. Declared values `n_frames=9` in medium and `grid_h=28` in easy are rejected even though the public `AXES` ranges advertise them.

**Finding A2 — the generated object model does not cover the canonical structure.** The generator emits disjoint 3×3 color-4 frames with exactly one non-4 center per component; the reproduced sample has component non-4 counts `[1,1,1]`. Canonical labeled inputs have component non-4 counts `[1,3]`, `[2,3]`, `[1,4]`, and `[1,2,5]`. The current `self_check` rejects multiple canonical pairs and accepts all 46 destructive mutations tested by the strict battery, so it is not a reliable validator for the canonical task.

**Strict battery.** Five stages are green and seven fail: lint (missing `RULE_HASH`), self-check, defect lint, profile floor, semantic gate, override contract, and authority sync. The battery also reports active selected/canonical authority text divergence despite execution parity. Summary: `checks/audit/8b5f756cc8ea/battery/checks/8b5f756cc8ea_audit_battery_summary.json`.

**Reproduction.** The generated cases belong to the generator's own documented/default domain and each returns an empty `self_check` error list; the problem is that this domain is narrower and structurally different from canonical inputs. Run from the outer packet directory:

```bash
python3 review.py run python3 ../checks/audit/8b5f756cc8ea/reproduce.py
python3 review.py run python3 -m arcpuzzles check 8b5f756cc8ea \
  --battery --timeout 1800 --phase audit \
  --out ../checks/audit/8b5f756cc8ea/battery
```

The reproducer exits 0 and writes `checks/audit/8b5f756cc8ea/report.json`; the strict battery exits 1 after collecting all evidence. This is an actionable reproduced defect, not a proposed repair.
